title: Materialize the FA3-native Generative Media Studio application
rationale: CAP-111 already defines the Generative Media Studio control surface; implementation must materialize it rather than create a parallel capability.
Autom8AI is treated as a discovery catalog. Canonical donor provenance points to original upstream repositories and immutable revisions.
The application compiles provider-neutral requests only. Model Router, HRB, UAF, Secret Broker, security and evidence authorities remain unchanged.
The Studio exposes 6-20 second self-contained video shot control without turning that UI range into a provider or global architecture limit.
